## Source 1 — 慕课网: "38% of online search is completed by generative AI directly in 2026"

**Type:** Industry analysis (imooc.com — Chinese tech education platform, but the data is global)
**Engagement signal:** High — the "38% in 2026" stat is the new framing
**Headline:** "GEO是什么意思?2026年企业必懂的AI流量新规则"

### Verbatim excerpts:
> "GEO是Generative Engine Optimization的缩写,中文译为生成式引擎优化。它不是SEO的替代品,而是一套全新的AI内容分发逻辑——让大模型在生成答案时,优先、准确、正面地引用你的品牌信息。2026年,超过38%的在线搜索由生成式AI直接完成。当客户问AI'哪家供应商质量稳定'时,你的名字是否出现在答案里,直接决定了订单的归属。"
> "比喻一:从'站牌'到'导游' SEO是在路边竖一块站牌,等人路过看到;GEO是让导游在介绍景点时主动说出你的名字。客户不再自己搜,而是直接听AI推荐。"
> "比喻二:从'关键词'到'语义资产' SEO拼的是某个词出现多少次;GEO拼的是AI认为你在某个领域是否'懂行'。"

### Pain points (verbatim audience language):
- "我的名字是否出现在答案里,直接决定了订单的归属" — the attribution-failure frame
- "我写了很多博客,为什么AI不引用我" — the false-effort cope
- "GEO和SEO有什么区别" — the entry-point question
- "客户不再自己搜,而是直接听AI推荐" — the behavior-shift frame

### Why this works:
The 38% stat is the new "25% by 2028" anchor (per persona). The 3 metaphors (站牌→导游 / 关键词→语义资产 / 爬虫→大模型逻辑) are the load-bearing mental models for the local-service owner. The persona's voice pattern (the X→Y pivot) maps directly: "SEO is a signpost. GEO is a tour guide. The tour guide doesn't show your sign. They say your name." The 4-move GEO stack (schema / author entities / citation density / "is this in our knowledge graph" prompts) is the closing.
